bucket_reason: Parked by the stop rule: the left zone is safe in every generation computed but neither stable nor growing. A cheap way back in exists, so this is a priority call.
question: Keep #9 parked, as the stop rule says, or fund one stage to test whether its left zone settles into a 2-cycle across generations?

options.label: Keep parked
options.consequence: Costs nothing. Everything stays in scripts/induct (the window map, validated on the real gen 1 to 2 step) for a later attempt, after the higher-confidence machines are done.

options.label: One stage on the 2-cycle
options.consequence: About 2 h, 1-2 light processes. Iterate the window map to generation 10 or more with 3 window sizes. If generations g and g+2 agree on a zone that stops shrinking, write the invariant and go on to proof.md. Stop rule: if the agreement does not grow by gen 8, park for good.

Every zone tested is safe (0/80 nested); gens g and g-2 agree on 53, 91, 99 cells.
A 2-cycle is plausible but unshown; other machines are closer to a kill.
